name: PD 123 was established by Ordinance No. 16722, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 22, 1980. Ordinance No. 16722 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 16722 was amended by Ordinance No. 22014, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 13, 1994, and Ordinance No. 23297, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 8, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16722; 22014; 23297; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 123 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 123 was established by Ordinance No. 16722, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 22, 1980. Ordinance No. 16722 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 16722 was amended by Ordinance No. 22014, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 13, 1994, and Ordinance No. 23297, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 8, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16722; 22014; 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 123 is established on property generally located between Turner Way and Churchill Way, east of Preston Road. The size of PD 123 is approximately 4.5 acres. (Ord. Nos. 16722; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-123.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development/Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-123.104.DEVELOPMENT/CONCEPTUAL PLAN.
(a)Development and use of the Property must comply with the development/conceptual plan (Exhibit 123A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development/conceptual plan, the provisions of this article control.
(b)The development/conceptual plan is the development plan for Phase 1 and the conceptual plan for Phase 2. A development plan for Phase 2 must be approved by the city plan commission before the issuance of any building permit in that phase. No time limit exists for the submission of the Phase 2 development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.105.USES. The uses allowed in this PD are as shown on the development/conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.106.FLOOR AREA. Maximum permitted floor area is 46,560 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.107.PARKING. Parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 51. Location of the parking must be provided as shown on the development/conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.108.SCREENING. Screening must be provided as shown on the development/conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.109.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Enrollment
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.110.ENROLLMENT. Enrollment is limited to 435 full-time students. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-123.111.LANDSCAPING.
(a)Except as provided below, landscaping and tree mitigation must be provided in accordance with Article X.
(b)Landscape buffer strips must be provided as shown on the development/conceptual plan.
(c)Subject to city licensing requirements, trees located in the right-of-way adjacent to the northern property line may remain and may be used to satisfy Article X landscaping requirements. If any tree in the right-of-way is, however, removed, it must be replaced by the owner on the property in accordance with Article X. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.112.FENCING. All outdoor play areas must be enclosed by a minimum four-foot-high fence. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508)

sections.title: Streets, Alleys, And Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-123.113.STREETS, ALLEYS, AND PAVING.
(a)All required paving must be in accordance with the requirements established in Chapter 51.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 16722; 23297; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.114.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. The property must be developed in accordance with all other applicable ordinances and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23297; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.115.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article, together with all applicable provisions of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 16722; 25508)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-123.116.ZONING MAP. PD 123 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. Nos. 16722; 25508)
